title: Keys: sovg'a savatchasidagi sharob
caption: 🔍 Keys: sovg'a savatchasi posilkani to'xtatdi 📦 Nima keldi: kuryer orqali Amazon'dan tayyor «gourmet» sovg'a savatchasi — 79 $: • Shokolad va pechenye to'plami • Pishloq va kraker • Bir shisha qizil sharob Summa normadan ancha kam, lekin posilka to'xtadi. ⛔ Muammo: savatchada sharob bor edi. Alkogol va tamaki mahsulotlarini pochta va kuryer orqali olib kirish taqiqlangan — narxi ahamiyatsiz. Xaridor tavsifdagi «wine» so'zini ko'rmagan. 🛠 Qanday hal qilindi: sharob chiqarilmadi, qolgan tovarlar bo'yicha qaror kutildi — jo'natma bir necha kun kechikdi. ✅ Xulosa: sovg'a to'plamlari tarkibini oxirigacha o'qing. «wine», «champagne», «liqueur», «cigar» bo'lsa — olmang. 📄 Asos: VM 244-son, 1-ilova «a» izohi (VM 154-son, 09.04.2026 tahriri) — lex.uz Posilkangiz to'xtab qoldimi? Vaziyatingizni ko'rib chiqib, yo'l ko'rsataman 👇 💬 Maslahat olish Holat bojxona amaliyotidagi tipik vaziyatlar asosida tuzilgan. ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #keys
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#keys".
2) Center: a wicker gift basket with chocolates, crackers and cheese on a customs inspection counter; a wine bottle lifted out of the basket stands beside it with a bold crimson prohibition circle, and a large indigo magnifying glass hovers over the basket label. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of crimson (#E11D48); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Sovg'a savatchasi posilkani to'xtatdi"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Pochta va kuryerda alkogol taqiqlangan"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Keysni Claude tuzdi (tipik holat, real voqea emas). Narxlar misol uchun. Tekshiring: «Qanday hal qilindi» qatoridagi amaliyot (sharob chiqarilmadi, qolgan tovarlar bo'yicha qaror) tajribangizga mos kelsinmi — kerak bo'lsa tahrir qiling.
